create.name: Nathan Maingard
create.bio:
Nathan Maingard is a South African singer-songwriter, coach and facilitator who lives in Cape Town. He trained as a breathwork facilitator and holds coaching certifications in the Body-Based Breakthrough and InnerLifeSkills approaches. At the centre of his work is an idea he calls worth-ship, taken from the old meaning of the word worship: that a person's worth is already given rather than earned, and that much of the inner work is simply remembering it.

He works in a few connected ways. One-to-one clients meet him for coaching that draws on breath, presence and candid conversation, sometimes for a single session and sometimes over several months. Each Tuesday afternoon, Cape Town time, he hosts a free livestream on Insight Timer mixing songs, breathing practice and open sharing. He also designs workshops, keynotes and retreats for business leadership forums, combining breathwork, cold-water immersion and a song he writes on the spot from the group's own words. His YouTube channel carries short reflections, guided breathwork, a spoken prayer and episodes of his podcast, We Are Already Free.

courses.title: One-to-one coaching with Nathan Maingard
courses.description: Private coaching built around breath, presence and frank conversation, arranged as a single session or as ongoing work over months. It begins with a free introductory chat about whether the fit is right.

courses.title: Experiences for leadership groups and forums
courses.description: Keynotes, half-day and full-day workshops and custom retreats for business forums and leadership teams. Sessions combine breathwork, ice baths and a song composed live from what participants write.
